# Summit Exterior Group

> Summit Exterior Group is a Portland, Oregon contractor for roofing, siding, windows, bathroom and interior remodeling, and fencing. We serve the Portland metro area, the westside suburbs (Beaverton, Hillsboro, Tigard and nearby) and the North Oregon Coast (Seaside, Gearhart, Cannon Beach). Free, no-pressure inspections and estimates; financing available.

Contact: 971-396-3033 | info@summitexteriorsgr.com | 135 NW 9th, Portland, OR
Hours: Monday-Friday, 8am-6pm
Reviews: rated 5.0 on Thumbtack (5 reviews).

## Services
- [Roofing](https://summitexteriorsgr.com/roofing.html): inspections, repairs and replacements
- [Siding](https://summitexteriorsgr.com/siding.html): siding installation and replacement
- [Windows](https://summitexteriorsgr.com/windows.html): replacement windows
- [Remodeling](https://summitexteriorsgr.com/remodeling.html): bathroom and interior remodeling
- [Fencing](https://summitexteriorsgr.com/fencing.html): fence installation
